fieldValues.title: A live transcript beside the minutes, linked by time and by selection
fieldValues.move: Show the transcript arriving in a panel beside the editor during a meeting. Store a time window on each minute as it is started, let the writer select the words a minute came from, and after the meeting have an agent propose further links for a tick or deny (srs-web#617).
fieldValues.does_not_fix: It does not make the transcript more accurate or name speakers. It does not decide which transport carries the stream: the relay sends transcript text through Cloudflare and each write reloads the editor, while reading a local stream from the bridge is untested.
fieldValues.falsifier: Writers ignore the panel and take minutes as before; or the transcript's lag of 10 to 15 seconds makes the time window point at the wrong words too often to be useful.
source_ref: srs-context research note 472c6c47 (read from code; nothing run)
fieldValues.return_when: Minutes are mostly written after the meeting, when a transcript search covers the need.
